notes:
Summary: mid-market analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood as inference layer for customer-facing features. Started on Hosted API POC (embeddings + doc search) — good quality but cost spike under realistic traffic. Team now pivoting to Dedicated (VPC) for predictable cost and data isolation. Security is primary gating factor for procurement.

POC details / ask: 
- POC ran 5k queries/day for 10 days (embeddings + reranking). Initial hosted run cost ~ $1.6k/week; engineering wants guidance to hit $0.9k/week equivalence — Rafael suggested dedicated reserved pools + prefix caching.
- Performance target: 99th pctile latency < 120ms for chat short prompts; bulk embeddings throughput target 5k reqs/hour.
- Model preference: open-model family (Llama-variants, same tokenization); willingness to test Redwood-verified quantized variants.

Security / compliance: 
- Must pass security review for Dedicated/VPC: SOC2 Type II attestation, SSO/SAML integration (IdP: Okta), audit logs accessible for 12 months, retention controls for user data (30/90/ever options), customer-managed KMS for key isolation, option for data residency in us-east-1.
- Quote from Head of Security: "We cannot allow customer PII to touch shared tenancy endpoints — need VPC + KMS + retention SLA."

Commercial / Procurement: 
- Interested in 12–24 month committed capacity (reserved GPUs + burst). Looking for committed uplift pricing tiers and an explicit migration path from hosted to dedicated with credits for hosted usage.
- Procurement asks: sample contract redlines, SLAs for latency/uptime, penalties for extended downtime.

Technical blockers: 
- Need network peering diagram and prescriptive steps for VPC setup (CIDR ranges, NAT/IGW patterns).
- SAML integration test window: customer needs staging SAML endpoint for integration testing before production cutover.
- SOC2 evidence: prefer recent Type II PDF and statement of applicability.

Action items from last calls: 
- Rafael to share VPC design doc + sample network playbook (INF-2143) — due 2026-03-03.
- Maya to circulate draft pricing sheet and term options to procurement by 2026-03-05.
- Customer to run second POC using Dedicated dev pool (2x A100 equivalent) scheduled tentatively for 2026-03-15 if security sign-off progresses.

Notes style: shorthand, call excerpts, and date-stamped bullets. Follow-up frequently references Drive docs and Fireflies transcript (ff-2026-02-18-01).
